sum_insured_options: Schedule-defined tiers (India SI) — VERIFY exact range

room_rent.note: Room rent up to room category as per Sum Insured per Schedule; proportionate deduction if higher; higher SI tiers may have no cap — VERIFY exact category

icu.note: ICU charges covered under Hospitalization Expenses; proportionate deduction not applicable to ICU — VERIFY no separate cap

copayment.note: No mandatory per-claim co-pay on base. Zonal co-pay applies only if treating in a higher zone than premium zone (% per Schedule); +10% additional co-pay penalty if prolonged-hospitalization (>10 days) intimation is delayed

sub_limits.note: Modern/Advanced Treatments and Robotic/Cyber Knife covered up to full Sum Insured; no disease-wise caps found — VERIFY

deductible.note: Optional deductible may be available — VERIFY

maternity.note: Maternity excluded on base (Excl-18); available via optional 'ManipalCigna Lifetime Plus' add-on (D.IV.3) incl. infertility, oocyte donor, surrogacy

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is offered (base); value Schedule/variant-defined and modifiable via optional 'Lifetime Plus' add-on; base % not stated in wording — VERIFY

restoration.note: D.II.14: reinstates utilized portion of Base SI unlimited times per Policy Year; not for same illness already claimed in the year; not for Any One Illness

domiciliary.note: D.II.8 Domiciliary Expenses incl. 60/180-day pre/post hosp

organ_donor.note: D.II.7 Donor in-patient expenses up to SI

ambulance.note: D.II.6 Road Ambulance up to Schedule limit — VERIFY ₹ cap; Air Ambulance via optional HEALTH+ package

modern_treatments.note: D.II.10 Robotic & Cyber Knife and D.II.11 Modern/Advanced Treatments, both up to full Sum Insured

consumables.note: Medical Devices & Non-Medical Items via optional HEALTH+ package (D.III.1.ii)

global_cover.note: Worldwide medical emergency hospitalization via optional Lifetime Plus add-on

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded on base (Excl-18, optional add-on); zonal co-pay on cross-zone treatment; +10% co-pay if delayed intimation of prolonged stay

optional_riders.display: HEALTH+ (Air Ambulance, Non-Medical Items, Bariatric, Hospi Cash, Tele-consult), WOMEN+ (cancer screening/vaccination), Lifetime Plus (Maternity/infertility/oocyte/CB modification/worldwide emergency)
